D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Kenneth Casner runs furthest behind in Johnson, Washakie, Big Horn. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: Women, 51% of voters, 39 to 56, where a 5 point gain is worth 2.54 points; Incomes under $50K, 43% of voters, 36 to 59, where a 5 point gain is worth 2.13 points; College graduates, 42% of voters, 40 to 56, where a 5 point gain is worth 2.10 points.

The forecast's worst groups for Kenneth Casner: Immigration voters 7 to 85, Voters who can afford daily costs 22 to 70, 2024 voters who skipped 2022 25 to 68. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
